verdict_rule.candidate_worthy: Positive with a 95% interval excluding zero under Metric M at the identified phi on both split families, not significantly negative under Metric O at prior 0.0706 on either family, and not contradicted by the historical transitions
verdict_rule.declared: before any Part 2 number was read

config.status: Read-only offline evaluation of a gate-filtered D6 vector; nothing fitted, no candidate, submission or upload in this run

caveats: Metric M scores pseudo-negative rows whose labels are a function of primary log2fc, and p_active is a calibrated predictor of primary log2fc, so a gate filter raises Metric M precision partly by construction; see the gate diagnosis run
Metric O conditions on the strong-primary region and cannot reward correct down-ranking of weak-primary rows
The filtered blind ordering contains both components of the score that selected the deployed payload, so its agreement on the sep15->oct03 transition is not independent
Blind rows were never primary screened; the blind p_active values are extrapolation
Nothing is refitted; all scores are frozen
